concept: One accent bar keeps time: it is the title rule, the list bars, a cube, the chart columns, and the end-title rule the loop starts from.

beatMap.lands: The tick steps across the rule on each kick; the headline words rise on beats 1-3; the brand hangs under the rule.
The headline holds; the bar counter fills one cell per beat; the headline leaves on beat 7.
Impact on beat 8. The rule becomes the first list bar; points 2 and 3 grow out of it on beats 9 and 10.
A reader square steps down the rows on each beat while the points hold.
Impact on beat 16. The first bar folds into a cube that turns a quarter on beats 17-19.
The cube drops into four columns that rise on eighth notes; the stat counts up on beats 20-21 under a riser.
Strongest impact on beat 24: the last column floods the frame and wipes up to reveal the end title; the subhead lands on 24.5 and the CTA on 26-27.
The end title holds while the arrow nudges on each beat; from beat 30 everything retracts to the tick of frame 0.

handoffs.element: The accent rule grows into the first list bar.
The first list bar folds into the front face of the cube.
The cube drops and splits into chart columns.
The last chart column floods the frame and becomes the end-title rule.

sound.concept: A four-on-the-floor kick is the accent bar's step; every word is a plucked note on its beat, and the flood is the downbeat impact.

cueMap.kick: The tick steps and the bar counter fill on every beat.
cueMap.impact: Beats 8, 16, and 24: the rule becomes the list, the list becomes the cube, the flood reveals the end title.
cueMap.riser: Beats 20-24: the stat counts up into the flood.
cueMap.headline: Each headline word rises on its pluck.
cueMap.point1: Each point grows out of the previous bar on its pluck.
cueMap.stat: The stat lands on a lead note.
cueMap.cta: The CTA words land on lead notes on beats 26-27.

findings.issue: The headline and brand clipped at max length because the width estimate was too low for wide glyphs.
findings.fix: fitWords now measures text with the real font on a canvas.

findings.issue: Beats 4-7, 11-13, 23, and 28-29 had no visible motion.
findings.fix: Added a bar counter that fills one cell per beat for the whole loop.

findings.issue: The last headline word overlapped point 1 at frame 117.
findings.fix: The headline exit starts a beat earlier.

findings.issue: The flood covered the end title for a whole beat.
findings.fix: The flood now wipes upward from the impact and reveals the end title under it.
